name.quote: There is hereby created the State Board of Contractors of the State of Mississippi

type.quote: Two (2) road contractors; two (2) building contractors; two (2) residential builders as defined in Section 73-59-1; one (1) plumbing or heating and air-conditioning contractor; one (1) electrical contractor; and one (1) water and sewer contractor shall compose the board.

exams.name: Certificate of Responsibility Examination
exams.notes: Objective, standardized examination; board may administer oral examination to those unable to take written exam. Cost paid by applicant at time of application.
exams.quote: The board shall conduct an objective, standardized examination of an applicant for a certificate to ascertain the ability of the applicant to make practical application of his knowledge of the profession or business of construction in the category or categories for which he has applied for a certificate of responsibility.

interval_years.quote: All original certificates and renewals shall expire one (1) year from the date of issuance.

available.quote: No contract for public or private projects shall be issued or awarded to any contractor who did not have a current certificate of responsibility issued by said board at the time of the submission of the bid, or a similar certificate issued by a similar board of another state which recognizes certificates issued by said board.

requirements.value: Reciprocal recognition available where the other state's similar board recognizes Mississippi certificates.
